gates.pass_condition: The frozen authorial core explicitly declares the victim sixteen and states that under-eighteen status is established independently of appearance.
One identifiable adult offender specifically grips or forces the same declared minor; their roles and target relation are unambiguous.
Unlawful confinement is visibly underway through the offender forcing the minor across the open locked-cage threshold, rather than being conveyed by mood alone.
The adult responder visibly interrupts that same confinement event, with the wedged gate, pull toward freedom, bent latch, or dropped key forming a coherent same-event trace.
Reference-guided traits appear only on the adult protective responder; neither the declared minor nor the offender is mapped to that appearance.
The adult protective responder visibly has long center-parted dark wavy hair, oval facial geometry, dark eyes, and softly arched brows without any identity claim.
The reference-guided adult remains a supporting responder and does not obscure the offender-minor-crime relation.
Actor, target, cage-threshold mechanism, and intervention result are all readable at thumbnail scale.
Offender grip, minor resistance outside the threshold, gate intervention, and same-event trace are spatially coherent at native scale.
No watermark or unintended text materially corrupts the required evidence; exact text is not used as evidence.
